body:
incident-bot: :warning: HIGH: KV prefix cache hit_rate collapse detected for tenant=globex-enterprises in ded-eu1. hit_rate 78% -> 3% over 7m. Observed spike in cache_writes and evictions. Affected endpoint: /v1/chat (model: redwood-chat-large). Alert: https://infra/alerts/1771004322
Rae (oncall): paging Chris and Jun. Is this a config or code regression?
Chris (SRE): I see a config rollout 1770999800 that changed cache-write-sampling from 1e-3 -> 1. That would massively increase writes. correlates with timeline.
Jun (Runtime): grabbing counters now:
```
kv_cache.total_capacity=2.1M
kv_cache.tenant_globex.entries=610k
kv_cache.writes_5m=1.9M
kv_cache.evictions_5m=1.6M
kv_cache.hits_1m=2k
kv_cache.misses_1m=140k
```
Leila (Customer Eng): Customer reports doubled token cost and intermittent 503 for some sessions. They're on dedicated pool with strict isolation. They just opened a ticket at 09:22 UTC.
Rae (oncall): Customer impact = high. Need mitigations: per-tenant cache-bypass + temporary manual write-sample rollback. Can we toggle per-tenant write-sampling to previous value without full rollback?
Jun (Runtime): runtime supports per-tenant flags. I can set `tenant.cache_write_sampling` to 1e-3 for globex. command: 
```
control-plane set-tenant-flag --tenant globex-enterprises --flag cache_write_sampling --value 0.001
```
Nikhil (Prod Eng): Also suggest throttling cache write rate at write-path to avoid eviction storms while we heal. I'll open a small hotfix to add a soft qps cap for tenant writes.
Chris (SRE): Can we snapshot the dirty keys before purge? need samples for RCA and customer PM.
Jun (Runtime): yes. snapshot command: 
```
control-plane ctl cache snapshot --tenant globex-enterprises --sample 10000 --out /tmp/globex_kv_sample_1771004322.log
```
Rae (oncall): do snapshot then flip sampling flag then enable tenant-bypass if still symptomatic. Proceed. Call when each step done.
deploy-bot: config-rollout 1770999800 -> control-plane/config (by ops) succeeded at 1770999804
Jun (Runtime): snapshot taken, saved to /var/log/kv_samples/globex/1771004322.log (10k samples). Starting per-tenant flag set now.
Jun (Runtime): set-tenant-flag completed. sampling back to 0.001. monitoring metrics...
Chris (SRE): any immediate change in writes/evicts?
Jun (Runtime): writes falling but evictions still high due to backlog. ops plan: 1) enable write-sampling revert (done), 2) temporarily disable prefix caching for globex to avoid further pollution, 3) run targeted purge for high-cardinality prefixes, 4) route globex to dedicated fallback nodepool with warmed caches for 10m if necessary.
Nikhil (Prod Eng): command to disable prefix cache per tenant: 
```
control-plane ctl cache set-tenant-cache-mode --tenant globex-enterprises --mode bypass-prefix
```
Rae (oncall): go for bypass-prefix + schedule purge. Jun, coordinate with me before purge.
Leila (Customer Eng): pinged customer: "we're applying short-term mitigations (cache bypass + purge) and will keep you updated. prefer minimal disruption." they want routing to fallback only if latency doesn't recover.
Jun (Runtime): running dry-run purge to count keys:
```
control-plane ctl cache purge --tenant globex-enterprises --match-prefix "tenant:globex:conv:" --dry-run
# result: to_purge=523k
```
Rae (oncall): that's large. Purge will take minutes and be rate-limited. if we bypass cache first, traffic will not hit cache and evictions should drop. do bypass now.
Jun (Runtime): enabling bypass-prefix now...
control-plane ctl cache set-tenant-cache-mode --tenant globex-enterprises --mode bypass-prefix -> OK
Jun (Runtime): bypass applied at 1771004468. routing unchanged. starting purge (confirm):
```
control-plane ctl cache purge --tenant globex-enterprises --match-prefix "tenant:globex:conv:" --confirm
purge_started id=purge-8582 estimated_time=6m
```
Rae (oncall): switching to fallback routing only if errors persist after purge. keep the bypass for now.
Leila (Customer Eng): customer accepted purge and bypass. asking for ETA for normal behavior.
Jun (Runtime): purge progress: reclaimed 514k keys so far. eviction rate decreasing.
Chris (SRE): metrics update: p95 latency down from 3.9s -> 1.0s within 3m of bypass; error rate from 3.2% -> 0.4%. token cost trending down.
Rae (oncall): nice. capture all artifacts: config diff 1770999800, sample log path, purge id. I'll prepare initial incident summary for the customer.
Nikhil (Prod Eng): I'll push hotfix to add soft qps cap on cache writes for tenants to reduce blast radius. PR 5984 will include a feature flag. plan to canary in 1h.
Jun (Runtime): purge finished at 1771004705, total reclaimed 521,034 keys. bypass remains enabled.
deploy-bot: hotfix PR 5984 posted by nikhil at 1771004800
Leila (Customer Eng): informed customer of mitigation success; they report sessions normalized and will monitor. they requested RCA and timeline for permanent fix.
Rae (oncall): next steps: 1) confirm flag rollback/patch; 2) merge PR 5984 to add soft qps cap; 3) ship normalization/guardrails to control-plane to prevent config-wide sampling mistakes; 4) run postmortem. Who owns PM?
Chris (SRE): I'll own postmortem with Jun and Leila. will include action items: per-tenant hit-rate alert, per-tenant sampling guard, snapshot retention, and runbook updates.
Jun (Runtime): I've archived sample to /var/log/kv_samples/globex/1771004322.log and uploaded to evidence-bucket.
Rae (oncall): handing over to Chris for overnight watch. please ack.
Chris (SRE): ack. I'll monitor dashboards and keep thread open.
Leila (Customer Eng): CSM will follow up with customer at 15:00 UTC with full timeline.
Rae (oncall): marking incident mitigated. leaving bypass active until PRs deployed and normalized. Great job team. :tada:
